source: GPT visual review of the 10 approved Google Drive pilot images
rules: Image-level observations only; no confirmed material facts.
Inference rows are explicitly separated from direct observations.
No reference-level synthesis is included in this file.
Product-design and promotional-visual scopes are separate.

observations.observed_value: Dark forest-green and black-green beads are mixed with clear to gray-green elements and silver-toned metal accents.
The bracelet uses mostly round beads, with one rectangular/cube-like bead and one oversized circular focal element.
The oversized circular focal element is held by silver-toned hardware and has a small dangling leaf-and-chain detail below it.
The promotional composition is a collage combining bracelet views with mountain and forest photographs on a pale gray background.
The oversized framed circular element likely functions as the primary visual anchor of the bracelet.
Bead sizes and forms vary around the circle, producing an uneven rhythm rather than a uniform round-bead sequence.
The rectangular bead and the large circular focal element occupy different sides of the bracelet, creating visible asymmetry.
A short silver-toned chain with leaf-like charms hangs from the focal area as a secondary vertical line.
The bracelet is centered alone against a pale gray field with substantial negative space.
The bracelet is built from relatively large clear-to-gray spherical elements with strong visual mass on the wrist.
Several large transparent spherical elements are visibly seated in or framed by silver-toned metal structures.
The visible large elements range from highly transparent to cloudy gray, with internal inclusions or veining apparent in several pieces.
The image uses a tight wrist close-up against a neutral gray background, emphasizing scale and surface detail.
Because the elements are large and sparsely repeated, visible surface quality likely contributes strongly to the design's perceived impact.
Large round transparent-to-gray elements repeat in a serial sequence and are separated or connected by silver-toned hardware.
Although round forms dominate, at least one more irregular or faceted transparent element interrupts the repeated spherical rhythm.
A silver-toned dangling extension with several small charms appears at one end of the bracelet.
The bracelet is extended along the forearm rather than shown only as a closed circle, making the repeated structure easy to inspect.
The bracelet combines muted gray-green, dark green, smoky gray and pale green elements with silver-toned accents.
Round beads are mixed with at least one square/cube-like dark element and a small clustered section of much smaller beads.
One side contains a dense multi-element cluster with small green beads, clear elements and silver-toned details, while the opposite side remains simpler.
The bracelet is presented on a translucent dish held by hands in a warm neutral interior setting.
The denser cluster appears to be balanced by larger, calmer beads on the opposite side rather than by mirror symmetry.
On the wrist, larger gray-green round beads occupy most of the circumference while the denser decorative cluster is concentrated to one side.
Large round beads, medium geometric elements and very small clustered beads create three visibly different size scales.
Silver-toned spacer and connector elements appear between several larger beads and around the denser cluster.
The bracelet is shown directly on the wrist against a warm wood-and-textile background, revealing fit and off-center placement.
A dark faceted geometric element and a square/cube-like element contrast with the surrounding round beads.
The bracelet mixes translucent gray-green beads, clearer beads and darker opaque-to-semi-opaque elements.
The decorative cluster contains several small dark-green round elements, clear pieces and silver-toned fittings packed into a compact zone.
The bracelet is held close to the camera against a dark gray background, giving a clearer view of the asymmetric cluster and geometric pieces.
The bracelet uses a restrained gray, clear, smoky and blue-gray palette with silver-toned hardware.
Large round beads are combined with a prominent transparent faceted geometric piece and smaller hanging clear pieces.
A fine silver-toned chain descends from the bracelet and creates a long secondary line beyond the circular body.
The bracelet is shown against a black textured background with high-contrast white italic serif typography and a dark editorial mood.
The transparent faceted geometric piece likely serves as the main focal interruption within the otherwise round-bead sequence.
The large round elements vary from clear to smoky and blue-gray, with several showing visible internal clouding or inclusions.
A large transparent faceted geometric element is connected to the round-bead sequence with silver-toned hardware and sits visibly off-center.
A fine chain and small clear hanging elements extend from the bracelet as secondary details.
The bracelet is draped over a hand against a black background, combining a close wear view with the same high-contrast editorial typography.
The bracelet alternates large round gray/clear beads with a smaller number of geometric interruptions and silver-toned transitions.
The large transparent geometric piece, hanging details and dark round elements are not mirrored across the bracelet, producing an asymmetric composition.
Glossy transparent pieces, cloudy gray beads, darker opaque-to-translucent beads and reflective metal create strong surface and opacity contrast.
The bracelet is held close across the fingers on a dark background, emphasizing the full circular arrangement and the large faceted focal piece.
The low-saturation gray palette and spacing between major forms create a visually restrained, cool and quiet impression.
